flaws: monolingual: only one language variant on disk; lifting_plan: add second variant when needed
lifting_plan: Currently hand-authored. Path to observation-derived: (1) instrument target program/framework via eBPF/Frida/tracer; (2) observe actual primitives invoked; (3) derive redefinition from observed sequences. The hand-authored card is a hypothesis to validate.

metadata.note: The 'compressed' Collatz map T_c, often used in the literature: T_c(n) = n/2 for even n and (3n+1)/2 for odd n, folding the halving that always follows 3n+1 (3n+1 is even when n is odd) into the step. The redefinition is its bit-level form: the parity test is n & 1 and both halvings are exact shifts. T_c reaches 1 iff the plain map T does, and cycles transfer, but T_c is not one T step (T(7) = 22, T_c(7) = 11); the earlier source form T(n) named an undefined function, so the card could not be evaluated, and it would have compared two different maps.
